loader.semantics: Offline AutoTokenizer and AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained; BF16; device_map full model CUDA0; local_files_only; eval

native_contract.projections: q/k initial16 heads; value32 heads; q/k repeat_interleave2 on head dim before helper, giving32 heads; all head dims128
native_contract.qk_normalization: Native reference only: BF16 input l2norm x*rsqrt(sum(x*x,dim=-1)+1e-6), before FP32 conversion. PACE AppendixD differs in sequencing: buffer key must be rounded then L2-normalized; do not normalize before buffer encoding and normalize again.
native_contract.beta: b.sigmoid(); native BF16 projected b gives BF16 beta; helper casts to FP32
native_contract.g: -A_log.float().exp()*softplus(a.float()+dt_bias); FP32 log decay; helper uses exp(g)
native_contract.equation: alpha=exp(g); S_decay=alpha*S_prev; memory=sum_Key(S_decay*k); delta=(v-memory)*beta; S=S_decay+k outer delta; y=sum_Key(S*q_scaled)
native_contract.output_dtype: Native core result is converted to original query dtype BF16 before gated RMS norm/output projection
native_contract.first_forward: No previous state -> native chunk helper even seq_len1; subsequent seq_len1 -> recurrent helper
native_contract.native_chunk: Pads token dimension to native chunk_size; BF16 normalization before FP32, triangular delta-rule transformations; returns only unpadded outputs
native_contract.cache: DynamicCache initialized automatically for first use_cache=True call; native layer reads layers[layer_idx].recurrent_states[0] then cache.update_recurrent_state(last_recurrent_state,layer_idx)
native_contract.cache_hazard: LinearAttentionLayer.lazy_initialization uses zeros_like(recurrent_state) and update uses copy_; returning full FP32 state leaves full FP32 resident cache
native_contract.cache_previous_state: has_previous_state[state_idx] is set by convolution state update, independent of recurrent tensor shape; conv buffer must remain native
native_contract.engineered_packed_integration: Scoped patch both native helpers, layer tracked by NativeLayerTracker; adapter owns packed base and finite buffer; helper returns BF16 output and tiny tensor marker to native cache, so native zeros_like/copy_ does not persist a dense state. Verify marker/counter and adapt audit accessors. This is an integration route, not a claim of paper method parity.
native_contract.ephemeral_dequantization: Ordinary Torch CUDA transient replay is implementable: unpack/dequantize base into temporary FP32, reconstruct buffered INT4 keys, normalize after rounding, replay buffered raw BF16 values/native beta/log-decays, compute current output before quantized boundary writeback, then release scratch. Persist only packed base/buffer/metadata/marker. Value semantics and quantizer conventions follow the declared paper audit. This satisfies storage requirements if no dense recurrent tensor remains reachable after helper returns; runtime may be slow.

quantizer_reuse.key_axis: [B,H,Key128,Value128] reshape[B,H,4,32,128], extrema reduction dim=-2. Fixed value column, groups of32 along Key.
quantizer_reuse.historical_asym8: group_codecs B2 includes zero: a=min(group_min,0), b=max(group_max,0), scale=max(b-a,1e-12)/255 FP32, integer uint8 zp=round(-a/scale), codes=clamp(round(x/scale)+zp,0,255); integer centered subtraction before FP32 decode
quantizer_reuse.historical_asym4: int4_codec same operation graph /15; UINT8 container codes0..15, FP32 scales; explicitly packed_INT4_cache=False
quantizer_reuse.mismatch_to_PACE: Existing scale FP32 and unpacked uint8 INT4 plus full FP32 recurrent carrier do not satisfy new FP16-scale packed mixed4/8 residency; use reference structure/tests, not unchanged codec.
quantizer_reuse.rounding: Old codecs use torch.round (nearest even); paper rounding/FP16 scale quantization order/zero-range convention must be explicitly verified and frozen
quantizer_reuse.forbidden_reuse: Do not use QwenKeyHadamardPatch or WScale/RowBal/H128 transforms for PACE; reuse NativeLayerTracker only

frozen_protocol.sampler: Extract exact AST via protocol_binding, preserve original functions/constants and native TopK ties
frozen_protocol.masks: Boolean generated-output token presence mask; prompt excluded; fresh CUDA generator.manual_seed1 per trajectory
frozen_protocol.prompt: raw_messages one user message; apply_chat_template tokenize=False/add_generation_prompt=True/enable_thinking=True then add_special_tokens=False; frozen input_ids/hash reused
frozen_protocol.stop: tokenizer EOS and valid im_end/endoftext ids; last sampled EOS or length cap token is not forwarded
frozen_protocol.scorer: Frozen V4 exact source; never modify
frozen_protocol.conflict: User deterministic=True versus verified existing protocol deterministic_algorithms=False; Engine also sets cudnn.deterministic=False, cuda_matmul TF32=False and cudnn TF32=True. User instructs verifiable frozen historical protocol precedence. Must document explicit resolution, never silently claim True.
frozen_protocol.prefill: Frozen Engine one-token full-model forwards. PrefillPeriod256 is adapter writeback scheduling, not achieved by changing chunk_size for first seq_len1 helper call. Full-model multi-token batching changes execution arithmetic and needs explicit qualification.
